paragraphs: FieldWare sells cloud-based software for judicial professionals, community supervision teams, and public safety personnel at city, county, and state agencies. Its modules cover pretrial, parole, and probation supervision, workforce management with a companion mobile app, and court notification and attendance.

The CourtNotify suite centralizes subpoena processes for courts, prosecutors, defense attorneys, public safety officials, and civilian witnesses, and can serve one agency or unite several. A companion CourtNotify mobile app for iOS and Android carries court notifications in real time and uses geofencing to record officer check in and check out times at courthouses.

FieldWare hosts in an Azure Government environment it describes as FedRAMP-compliant and runs continuous BreachLock penetration testing. A testimonial attributed to Lt. Gene Summers of the Dallas Police Department says the first year of implementation saved approximately $2.2 million in court overtime.
